LanguageData.MCDT.DesignatedOnlyTT: Only mine tiles that are designated for mining
LanguageData.MCDT.SetTargetTT: Order the turret to mine a specific rock. Can only target rocks in range with line of sight.
LanguageData.MCDT.OresRocksTT: In this mode, the mining turret automatically drill nearby ores and rocks. Click to switch mode.
LanguageData.MCDT.RocksOnlyTT: In this mode, the mining turret only drill nearby rocks. Click to switch mode.
LanguageData.MCDT.OresOnlyTT: In this mode, the mining turret only drill nearby ores. Click to switch mode.
LanguageData.MCDT.IdleDrillTT: You have an idle drill turret. You should maybe move it or designate more rocks to drill.
LanguageData.MCDT.EnableIdlePowerDrawTT: When enabled, drill turrets only draw 25W while idle (no target in range), ramping up to full power while actively drilling.
LanguageData.MCDT.AllowUnmannedDrillingTT: When disabled, a pawn must operate the turret for it to drill. Operators retain their existing speed bonus.
LanguageData.MCDT.UnlimitedRangeTT: Search all mineable targets on the current map instead of limiting targets to the turret's range.
LanguageData.MCDT.IgnoreWallsTT: Allow drilling targets through walls and other line-of-sight blockers.
LanguageData.MCDT.PrioritizeDesignatedTargetsTT: Automatically select targets marked for mining before other valid targets.
LanguageData.MCDT.UseFixedDrillDamageTT: Use a fixed damage value per drilling hit instead of scaling damage with drilling efficiency.
LanguageData.MCDT.PowerModeLowTT: Draws 500W and mines at half speed. Click to switch mode.
LanguageData.MCDT.PowerModeMediumTT: Draws 1000W and mines at normal speed. Click to switch mode.
LanguageData.MCDT.PowerModeHighTT: Draws 1500W and mines at 1.5x speed. Click to switch mode.
